_about: Show the interface as it is needed (docs/PLAYER_EXPERIENCE.md Part 2, our own touch): on a brand-new farm a button listed here waits until a goal that needs it is open (one of its `verbs` is a task's verb), the farm reaches its `level`, or (`inbox`) something waits in the inbox; then it appears with a short shine and stays (saved). A farm with every chain of `after` done (old saves, a farm past Welcome) sees everything; a button not listed always shows. Buttons: tool:<HudTools id>, menu:<HudSide key>.
